text: I received my dream job offer today and cannot stop smiling!
The sorrow of parting with my best friend is too heavy to bear.
I am furious that my order was cancelled without any explanation!
The loud bang in the middle of the night made me jump in sheer panic.
What a surprise to see snow falling in the desert this morning!
The sight of moldy decayed fruit was totally nauseating and gross.
I am happy about winning the race but scared about defending the title.
I was shocked and overjoyed when my book became a bestseller!
Their deceitful conduct made me feel sick with anger and disgust.
The sudden loss of our family home in the fire left us horrified and grieving.
